params.caption: 🖥️ 20-year-old Radeon HD 2000/3000 cards finally get a Linux video fix AMD's Radeon HD 2000 and 3000 GPUs, launched nearly two decades ago, are getting a Linux patch for a long-standing bug that corrupted video playback. The fix came from a new kernel contributor who used AI to help write a patch for the drivers running his own old Radeon card. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 14:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @AMD 🛠️ React 👍 if you still run old hardware · 💬 What's the oldest GPU you own? #AMD #Radeon #Linux #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
